maudhui: (1) Every person has the right to freedom and to live as a free person. (2) For the purposes of preserving individual freedom and the right to live as a free person, no person shall be arrested, imprisoned, confined, detained, deported or otherwise deprived of his freedom save only - (a) under circumstances and in accordance with procedures prescribed by law; or (b) in the execution of a judgment, order or sentence given or passed by the court following a decision in a legal proceeding or a conviction for a criminal offence.
